name: Yarris Wendith
keeps: the oath he is named for breaking
does: Carries the chain across at the syndication and brings the other world's back. Signs for what he carried and for nothing else.
reason: He confessed unprompted to crimes nobody had accused him of.
text: Yarris wendith of the long gallery, carries between for the 13th tranche, doors 115 to 123. Keeps the oath he is named for breaking. Reads Major Thomas Weir.
